cs_saving_face.definition: Letting a person keep their standing, especially after a mistake or a failure.
cs_saving_face.example: The manager saved face by letting the report be corrected without naming who had written it.

deep_dive.definition: A long, detailed examination of one subject.
deep_dive.example: We did a deep dive on the churn numbers before the review.

gd_gaslighting_vocabulary.definition: The small set of fixed sentences used to rewrite an account, at work and at home.
gd_gaslighting_vocabulary.example: The gaslighting vocabulary is short: you are misremembering, I never said that.

quality_control.definition: The process of checking that output meets its requirements before it is used or shipped.

sleep_efficiency.definition: The share of your time in bed that you were actually asleep. A long night can still be an inefficient one.
sleep_efficiency.example: I was in bed for nine hours and my sleep efficiency was about seventy per cent.
